## UpLift Beyond
這是一個精心篩選的 Vanilla+ 整合包，在保留原版遊戲氛圍的同時，透過強化效能、提升便利性與視覺優化，為您帶來更流暢的 Minecraft 核心體驗。

## 📋 模組列表

## ⚙️ 效能優化
Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Distant Horizons, Entity Culling, More Culling, Dynamic FPS, Forge Config API Port, Konkrete, CreativeCore

## 🧩 核心函式庫
Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Cloth Config, YACL, Puzzle API, Text Placeholder API, Language Reload, CICADA Library

## 🕹️ 玩法與介面
Simple Voice Chat, Controlify, Essential Mod, FancyMenu, Mod Menu, More Chat History, Mouse Tweaks, Zoomify, Xaero's Map, Paginated Advancements, Shulker Tooltip, Sit, Better Mount HUD, FastQuit, Chat Heads, Ping Wheel, YOSBS, Main Menu Credits, Cherished Worlds

## 🎨 視覺與氛圍
Iris Shaders, LambDynamicLights, Blur+, BetterGrassify, Gamma Utils, Sound Physics Remastered, AmbientSounds, Presence Footsteps, Particle Rain, Continuity
